info.title: NominalPayments
info.description:
## Quickstart

1. **Authenticate**: obtain your API key from your NominalPayments manager.
2. **Create a payment**: POST to `/v1/payments/process` with the required fields.
3. **Redirect the user** (fund only): redirect to `checkout_url` from the response, or use `api_only: true` for headless mode.
4. **Listen for webhooks**: implement an endpoint at your `notify_endpoint` to receive callbacks on payment state changes. Verify the `X-Signature` header on every request.
5. **Poll if needed**: optionally poll `GET /v1/payments/{ref_num}/resolve` for real-time status.

Example (Fund, UPI):
```json
{
  "value": "1000.00",
  "notify_endpoint": "https://merchant.example.com/webhook",
  "iso_ccy": "INR",
  "client_ref": "order-001",
  "tx_type": "fund",
  "processing": "direct",
  "channel_code": "upi",
  "user_ref": "user_9812345678",
  "landing_url": "https://merchant.example.com/return"
}
```

---

## Introduction

NominalPayments processes Pay-In (fund) and Pay-Out (disburse) transactions. Supported payment rails for India: UPI, UPI Intent, UPI Paytm (flash), UPI PhonePe (turbo), IMPS, and card acquiring.

All amounts are passed as decimal strings. The `client_ref` field is your idempotency key — always unique per payment.

---

## Fund (Pay-In) modes

- **Widget** (default): redirect the user to `checkout_url` returned in the response.
- **Headless / API-only**: set `api_only: true` — no redirect, payment credentials returned directly in `transfer_details`.

---

## Webhook signature verification

Every webhook sent to your `notify_endpoint` includes an `X-Signature` header.
The value is an HMAC-SHA256 or RSA signature of the raw request body. Obtain the verification key from your manager.

Node.js example (HMAC-SHA256):
```js
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

function verifyWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret) {
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(rawBody)
    .digest('hex');
  return timingSafeEqual(
    Buffer.from(expected),
    Buffer.from(signatureHeader)
  );
}
```

Return HTTP **200** to acknowledge. Any other code triggers retries for up to 24 hours.

---

## Payment outcome values

| `outcome` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pending` | In progress |
| `settled` | Successfully completed |
| `settled_partial` | Partially settled |
| `declined` | Declined or expired |
| `voided` | Reversed/cancelled |
| `disputed` | Chargeback initiated |
| `adjusted` | Amount adjusted |

---

## Error format

All errors return a unified JSON body:
```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "bad_request",
    "text": "value must be a valid money amount",
    "errors": {
      "value": ["value must be a valid money amount"]
    }
  }
}
```

| Category | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `bad_request` | 400 | Validation error |
| `payment_issue` | 400 | Business error (limit, ban, duplicate, …) |
| `auth_issue` | 401/403 | Authorization error |
| `server_issue` | 500 | Internal error |

---

## Test Cases (Production)

> **Note:** The test cases below use a live production token. Keep it confidential.

---

### Pay-In field requirements — must match exactly

The following fields are **strictly required** as specified in the schema. Using incorrect field names or formats will result in a `bad_request` error:

| Field | Correct | Wrong |
|---|---|---|
| CVV field name | `cvv` | `security_code`, `cvc`, `cvv2` |
| Expiry year | 4-digit integer, e.g. `2027` | 2-digit, e.g. `26` |
| Amount | Decimal string, e.g. `"1000.00"` | Integer `1000` |
| `channel_code` | `upi`, `upi_intent`, `imps`, `flash`, `turbo` | Any other value |
| `processing` for card | `card` (no `channel_code`) | `direct` with `channel_code` |

---

### Test 1 — Pay-In: UPI Standard

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/payments/process \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "value": "1000.00",
    "notify_endpoint": "https://webhook.site/your-id",
    "iso_ccy": "INR",
    "client_ref": "prod-order-unique-id-001",
    "tx_type": "fund",
    "processing": "direct",
    "channel_code": "upi",
    "user_ref": "user_id_999",
    "landing_url": "https://example.com"
  }'
```

---

### Test 2 — Get Payment Status (Resolve)

```bash
curl -X GET https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/payments/019e20c2-a148-7911-a6b3-d7bf00e327f3/resolve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67"
```

---

### Test 3 — Get Balance (Ledger)

```bash
curl -X GET https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/partner/ledger \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67"
```

---

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67" \

    "notify_endpoint": "https://webhook.site/your-id",
    "iso_ccy": "INR",
    "client_ref": "payout-test-unique-001",
    "tx_type": "disburse",
    "processing": "direct",
    "channel_code": "upi",
    "user_ref": "user_id_123",
    "payout_details": {
      "upi_id": "test-vpa@upi",
      "recipient_name": "Test Payout User"
    }
  }'
```

---

### Test 5 — Pay-Out: IMPS (Bank Account)

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67" \

      "acct_number": "987654321098",
      "bank_code": "HDFC0002060",

    }

```

---

### Test 6 — Pay-In: UPI Intent (Mobile App)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/payments/process \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67" \

```

---

### Test 7 — Pay-In: Card Acquiring

> **Corrections vs original test file:**
> - `security_code` -> must be `cvv` (per API spec and DTO `PaymentCardInfoDTO`)
> - `expiry_year: 26` -> must be `expiry_year: 2026` (4-digit integer)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/payments/process \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 5406c646-6012-4211-8287-6be097560a67" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "value": "1500.00",
    "notify_endpoint": "https://webhook.site/your-id",
    "iso_ccy": "INR",
    "client_ref": "payin-card-fixed-008",
    "tx_type": "fund",
    "processing": "card",
    "user_ref": "user_789",
    "landing_url": "https://example.com",
    "fund_details": {
      "card_info": {
        "card_number": "4111111111111111",
        "expiry_month": 12,
        "expiry_year": 2026,
        "cvv": "123",
        "holder_name": "IVAN TESTOV"
      }
    }
  }'
```

---

## Technical Limits (INR)

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Currency | INR |
| Min deposit | 300.00 INR |
| Max deposit | 50,000.00 INR |
| Supported channels | UPI, UPI Intent (Paytm, PhonePe) |

---

## Integration Test Report

Results from live production testing.

---

### Test 1 — Pay-In: UPI Intent (Paytm)

curl -X POST https://api.nominalpayments.app/v1/payments/pay_in \

**Response (201 Created):**

{
  "ref_num": "019e22ce-23df-7e32-9db7-b7cd6025cd9d",

  "transfer_details": {
    "type": "upi",
    "upi_account": "189695YW33@mairtel",

---

### Error: Amount below minimum (300 INR)

```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "payment_issue",
    "text": "Payment amount (100.00) is less than allowed minimum amount (300)"
  }
}
```

---

### Error: Amount exceeds maximum (50,000 INR)

```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "payment_issue",
    "text": "Payment amount (500000.00) is greater than allowed maximum amount (50000)"
  }
}
```

---

### Error: Duplicate idempotency key

```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "payment_issue",
    "text": "Payment with idempotency_key (xxx) already exists"
  }
}
```

---

### Error: Unauthorized (401)

```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": { "category": "auth_issue", "text": "Token not found" }
}
```

---

### Error: Payment not found (404)

```json
{
  "result": "fail",
  "issue": {
    "category": "payment_issue",
    "text": "Payment with id (null) not found"
  }
}
```

post.description:
Creates a deposit (fund) payment. The payer is redirected to `checkout_url`.

**No-UI / Headless mode:** set `api_only: true` — no redirect, payment credentials returned in `transfer_details`.

**Fund channels (`processing: direct`):**
- `channel_code: upi` — standard UPI
- `channel_code: upi_intent` — UPI Intent deep-link
- `channel_code: flash` — UPI via Paytm
- `channel_code: turbo` — UPI via PhonePe

**Card acquiring (`processing: card`):** no `channel_code` needed; pass `fund_details.card_info`.

`client_ref` is your idempotency key (5–64 chars). Reusing the same key within 1 second returns the same payment; after 1 second it returns a `409` conflict.

post.description:
Creates a payout — moves funds from the merchant to a recipient.

**Pay-Out channels:**
- `processing: direct` + `channel_code: upi` — payout to UPI VPA
- `processing: direct` + `channel_code: imps` — payout via IMPS (bank account + IFSC)
- `processing: card` — payout to card number (no `channel_code`)

`client_ref` is your idempotency key (5–64 chars). Reusing the same key within 1 second returns the same payment; after 1 second it returns a `409` conflict.

Check `outcome` field: `settled` = funds transferred, `declined` = failed.

get.description:
Retrieve the current status of a payment by its `ref_num`.

Use `outcome` to determine the final state:
- `pending` — still in progress
- `settled` — successfully completed
- `settled_partial` — partially settled
- `declined` — declined or expired
- `voided` — reversed/cancelled
- `disputed` — chargeback
- `adjusted` — amount adjusted

`settled_amount` may differ from `charge_amount` due to fees.

Returns the current account balance.

Pass `?account_type=CRYPTO_TRANSIT` to retrieve the crypto (USDT) balance. Default returns the P2P/fiat balance.

parameters.name: account_type
parameters.description: Account type to query. Default: P2P fiat balance.

Bearer.description: Bearer token. Obtain your API key from your NominalPayments manager.

FundDetailsSchema.description: Optional payer credentials for Pay-In. Which sub-fields are used depends on the channel.

holder_name.description: Cardholder name as printed on the card

PayoutDetailsSchema.description: Recipient credentials for Pay-Out. Use the fields relevant to the chosen channel.

bank_code.description: IFSC code (required when `acct_number` is provided; format: `XXXX0XXXXXX`)

card_num.description: Recipient card number for card payouts (Luhn-valid, spaces/dashes stripped automatically)

recipient_name.description: Required when any of `upi_id`, `acct_number`, or `card_num` is provided

tax_num.description: Tax identification number of the recipient (if required by jurisdiction)

PaymentStateSchema.description: Full payment state — returned on creation, status polling, and webhooks.

checkout_url.description: URL to redirect payer to (null for headless / api_only mode, and for disburse)

expires_at.description: Expiry datetime of the payment window (null if not yet assigned)

decline_cause.description: Human-readable reason for decline (null if not declined)

settled_amount.description: Actual credited amount after fees (null until settled)

transfer_details.description: Payment credentials for headless/API-only mode. Null in widget mode.

upi_account.description: Merchant UPI VPA (for non-headless widget mode)

closed_at.description: Payment completion datetime (null while still pending)
